instruction: Change the title color in slide 2 to green.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide 2 title 'How to Use This Presentation' to green color. Evaluator checks if font color is green by verifying RGB values (G>150, R<100, B<100).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies title by placeholder_format.type (types 1 or 3), avoiding fragile text-based search - this is a robust approach
Complete verification: checks ALL text runs across all paragraphs in the title, ensuring entire title is green
Proper color mode validation: explicitly checks color.type == 1 (RGB mode) before accessing rgb property, avoiding errors with theme/automatic colors
Good postconfig: saves file with Ctrl+S before evaluation to ensure state is persisted
Minor issue: green color threshold (G>200, R<100, B<100) is quite strict - may reject medium/dark greens like RGB(0,180,0) or RGB(0,128,0), though will correctly identify bright greens
Fallback title detection (first shape with text_frame) could theoretically select wrong shape, but is reasonable given primary detection by placeholder type
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider relaxing green threshold to G>128 (instead of G>200) to accept medium/dark greens while still excluding non-green colors
Optional: Add logging/debug output to indicate which detection method was used (placeholder vs fallback) for troubleshooting
